ja: 練習してたら、乗り切れたのに。
en: If I'd practiced, I'd have coped.
alternatives: I'd have coped if I'd practiced.
If I'd practiced, I'd have gotten through it.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞 と would have

ja: 大事なのは価格ではなく速さです。
en: It's speed, not price, that matters most.
alternatives: It's speed rather than price that matters most.
What matters most is speed, not price.
point: It's + 強調語 + that で強調したい語を挟む

ja: 売上は昨年から伸びています。
en: Sales have grown since last year.
alternatives: Sales have been rising since last year.
Sales have increased since last year.
point: since と現在完了、過去の一点なら過去形

ja: 拡大したら私たちの利幅は薄まる。
en: If we expanded, our margins would shrink.
alternatives: Our margins would shrink if we expanded.
If we grew, our margins would narrow.
point: margins は金額そのものではなく利幅。

ja: これは何の図ですか？
en: What is this chart?
alternatives: What does this chart show?
What's this chart about?
point: 疑問詞 what を文頭に。「図」は chart

ja: 動画を流して。
en: Start the video.
alternatives: Play the video.
Put the video on.
point: start は動画の再生を始める。

ja: 私、結論を飛ばした。
en: I skipped the conclusion.
alternatives: I left out the conclusion.
I missed out the conclusion.
point: skip は扱わずに飛ばす。

ja: 詳細は後で共有されます。
en: Details will be shared later.
alternatives: We'll share the details later.
You'll get the details later.
point: 未来の受け身は will be + 過去分詞

ja: あの時投資してれば、今ごろ首位だよ。
en: If we'd invested then, we'd be leading now.
alternatives: If we had invested then, we'd be on top now.
Had we invested then, we'd be leading now.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は if + had 過去分詞, would + 原形

ja: この数字が何を隠すか分かりますか？
en: Can you see what these figures obscure?
alternatives: Can you tell what these figures hide?
Do you see what these numbers conceal?
point: obscure は大事なことを見えにくくすること。

ja: このグラフ見てください。
en: Please look at this graph.
alternatives: Take a look at this graph.
Have a look at this graph.
point: 「見る」は look at＋対象

ja: これが当社製品です。
en: This is our product.
alternatives: Here is our product.
This is what we make.
point: 「弊社の」は our。this で手元のものを示す

ja: 上のグラフをご覧ください。
en: Please see the chart above.
alternatives: Please look at the graph above.
Please refer to the chart above.
Please see the graph above.
point: 「上の」は名詞のあとに above を置く

ja: この見積もりは、やや楽観的かも。
en: That estimate might be a touch optimistic.
alternatives: That estimate may be slightly optimistic.
That estimate could be a bit optimistic.
point: a touch + 形容詞で言い切りを避ける

ja: よく見ると、傾向が分かります。
en: Looking closely, you'll see a trend.
alternatives: If you look closely, you'll see a trend.
Look closely and you'll see a trend.
point: 「〜すると」は Looking closely の分詞構文

ja: 終わったら質問を受けます。
en: I'll field questions when I finish.
alternatives: Once I'm done, I'll take questions.
I'll take questions after I've finished.
point: when 節の中は未来でも現在形

ja: ご清聴に感謝します。
en: Thank you for listening.
alternatives: Thanks for listening.
Thank you for your attention.
point: for のあとは動名詞（-ing）

ja: 先に進んでもいい？
en: Can I move on?
alternatives: May I move on?
Is it okay to move on?
point: move on で「先へ進む」。許可は Can I / May I

ja: それまでに試作品は仕上げてた。
en: By then, we'd finished the prototype.
alternatives: By then, we had completed the prototype.
We had already finished the prototype by then.
point: 「その時までに完了」は過去完了

ja: 詳細を掘り下げる時間はないです。
en: There's no time to delve into details.
alternatives: We don't have time to go into detail.
We don't have time to dig into the details.
point: 「〜する時間」は time to do。「掘り下げる」は delve into

ja: まず要点をざっと確認させてください。
en: Let me run through the key points first.
alternatives: Let me quickly go over the key points first.
Let me walk you through the key points first.
point: run through は「ざっと確認する」の句動詞

ja: データ一点では、何も証明できません。
en: A single data point proves nothing.
alternatives: One data point proves nothing.
One data point can't prove anything.
point: data point は数えられる名詞なので a が要る

ja: 同僚に資料を見てもらった。
en: I had a coworker check my slides.
alternatives: A coworker checked my slides for me.
I had a coworker check the slides.
point: have＋人＋原形で「〜してもらう」

ja: 私が実演します。
en: I'll demonstrate it.
alternatives: I'm going to demonstrate it.
I'll show how it works.
point: demonstrate は実際に動かして見せる。

ja: 君は図を省くべきだよ。
en: You should omit diagrams.
alternatives: You should leave out diagrams.
You should skip the diagrams.
point: should は助言を表す。

ja: 部長に、発表を頼まれました。
en: My director asked me to present.
alternatives: I was asked by the director to present.
The director asked me to give the presentation.
point: ask + 人 + to do

ja: 背景の説明から始めます。
en: I'll start by explaining the background.
alternatives: Let me start by explaining the background.
I'll start with the background.
point: by のあとは動名詞（-ing）

ja: 利点は二つあります。
en: There are two advantages to this.
alternatives: This has two advantages.
This plan has two benefits.
point: 利点が二つなので There are

ja: これは写真です。
en: This is a photo.
alternatives: It's a photo.
This is a photograph.
point: a photo は一枚の写真。

ja: 私は写真を見せられる。
en: I can show photos.
alternatives: I can display pictures.
I can present photographs.
point: can は写真を見せられることを表す。

ja: 後で初めてリスクに気づいた。
en: Only later did I notice the risk.
alternatives: It was only later that I noticed the risk.
I didn't notice the risk until later.
point: Only later を前に出すと did + 主語 + 原形

ja: 十分間の発表です。
en: It's a ten-minute talk.
alternatives: The talk is ten minutes long.
This talk takes ten minutes.
point: ten-minute は単数形でハイフンでつなぐ

ja: ご質問のあった点を説明します。
en: I'll explain the point you raised.
alternatives: I'll go over the point you asked about.
I'll explain what you asked about.
point: 関係詞 that は目的語なら省ける

ja: 今、資料を配ってます。
en: I'm handing out copies.
alternatives: I'm passing out handouts.
I'm handing out the materials.
point: hand out は「配る」。今の動作は進行形

ja: 大事なのは、拡張できることです。
en: What matters is that it scales.
alternatives: What's important is that it can scale.
The key point is that it scales.
point: What matters is that 節で「大事なのは〜」

ja: 最近これを調べています。
en: I've been studying this lately.
alternatives: I've been looking into this lately.
Lately I've been researching this.
point: 今も続く動作は have been -ing

ja: データいつ集められたの？
en: When was the data collected?
alternatives: When was the data gathered?
When was that data collected?
point: 「集めた」は受け身なら was collected

ja: 伸びが鈍った訳を彼は知らないと思う。
en: I doubt he knows why growth tapered off.
alternatives: I don't think he understands why growth lost momentum.
I doubt he understands why growth slowed down.
point: taper off は伸びや勢いが徐々に弱まる。

ja: 予行してれば、うまくいった。
en: If I'd rehearsed, it'd have worked.
alternatives: It would've worked if I'd rehearsed.
If I had rehearsed, it would have worked.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had + 過去分詞

ja: 画面を共有中です。
en: I'm sharing my screen.
alternatives: I'm sharing the screen.
I'm showing my screen.
point: 「〜中」は進行形。share は共有する

ja: 彼は、こけたらどうするのかと聞いた。
en: He asked what we'd do if it flopped.
alternatives: He asked what we'd do if it bombed.
He asked us what we'd do if it flopped.
point: 間接疑問は平叙の語順。asked の後で would に下げる
